mapper.sql: select asset_id, project_id, chapter_id, scene_id, shot_id, character_id, asset_code, asset_name, asset_type, asset_scope, canonical_flag, status, version_no, source_asset_id, storage_provider, object_key, preview_object_key, mime_type, file_size, width, height, duration_ms, prompt_text, negative_prompt_text, generation_params_json, metadata_json, approved_by, approved_time, create_time from ai_video_asset
mapper.select: where asset_id = #{assetId} and del_flag = '0' for update
where source_asset_id = #{sourceAssetId} and asset_type = 'VIDEO_CLIP' and status in ('DRAFT', 'REJECTED') and del_flag = '0' order by asset_id desc limit 1

where project_id = #{projectId} and asset_type = 'CHARACTER_REFERENCE' and del_flag = '0' and (character_id = #{characterId} or json_unquote(json_extract(metadata_json, '$.characterCode')) = #{characterCode} or asset_code = concat('character-', #{characterCode}) or left(asset_code, char_length(concat('character-', #{characterCode}, '-chapter-'))) = concat('character-', #{characterCode}, '-chapter-')) order by case status when 'APPROVED' then 0 when 'GENERATED' then 1 when 'GENERATING' then 2 when 'DRAFT' then 3 else 4 end, canonical_flag desc, asset_id desc limit 1 for update
select version_no from ai_video_asset where project_id = #{projectId} and asset_code = #{assetCode} order by version_no desc, asset_id desc limit 1 for update
mapper.insert: insert into ai_video_asset (project_id, chapter_id, scene_id, shot_id, character_id, asset_code, asset_name, asset_type, asset_scope, canonical_flag, status, version_no, source_asset_id, duration_ms, prompt_text, negative_prompt_text, generation_params_json, metadata_json, create_by, create_time) values (#{projectId}, #{chapterId}, #{sceneId}, #{shotId}, #{characterId}, #{assetCode}, #{assetName}, #{assetType}, #{assetScope}, #{canonicalFlag}, #{status}, #{versionNo}, #{sourceAssetId}, #{durationMs}, #{promptText}, #{negativePromptText}, #{generationParamsJson}, #{metadataJson}, #{createBy}, now())
mapper.update: update ai_video_asset set chapter_id = null, character_id = #{characterId}, asset_scope = 'PROJECT', canonical_flag = 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where asset_id = #{assetId} and asset_type = 'CHARACTER_REFERENCE' and del_flag = '0'

update ai_video_asset set status = case when asset_type in ('SHOT_KEYFRAME', 'VIDEO_CLIP') then 'GENERATED' else 'APPROVED' end, storage_provider = #{storageProvider}, object_key = #{objectKey}, preview_object_key = #{previewObjectKey}, mime_type = #{mimeType}, file_size = #{fileSize}, content_hash = #{contentHash}, width = #{width}, height = #{height}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where asset_id = #{assetId} and status = 'GENERATING' and del_flag = '0'

update ai_video_asset set status = 'APPROVED', approved_by = #{updateBy}, approved_time = now(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where asset_id = #{assetId} and asset_type = 'SHOT_KEYFRAME' and status = 'GENERATED' and object_key is not null and del_flag = '0'

update ai_video_asset set prompt_text = #{promptText}, negative_prompt_text = #{negativePromptText}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where asset_id = #{assetId} and status in ('DRAFT', 'REJECTED') and del_flag = '0'

update ai_video_asset set prompt_text = #{promptText}, negative_prompt_text = #{negativePromptText}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, generation_params_json = #{generationParamsJson}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where asset_id = #{assetId} and asset_type = 'VIDEO_CLIP' and status in ('DRAFT', 'REJECTED') and del_flag = '0'

update ai_video_asset set status = 'GENERATING', generation_params_json = #{generationParamsJson}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where asset_id = #{assetId} and status = 'DRAFT' and object_key is null and del_flag = '0'

update ai_video_asset set status = 'GENERATING', metadata_json = case when metadata_json is null then null else json_remove(metadata_json, '$.generationError') end, generation_params_json = #{generationParamsJson}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where asset_id = #{assetId} and asset_type = 'VIDEO_CLIP' and status in ('DRAFT', 'REJECTED') and object_key is null and source_asset_id is not null and binary prompt_text = binary #{promptText} and ((binary negative_prompt_text = binary #{negativePromptText}) or (negative_prompt_text is null and #{negativePromptText} is null)) and duration_ms = #{durationMs} and del_flag = '0'

update ai_video_asset set duration_ms = #{durationMs}, generation_params_json = #{generationParamsJson}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where asset_id = #{assetId} and asset_type = 'VIDEO_CLIP' and status = 'GENERATING' and del_flag = '0'
update ai_video_asset set status = 'REJECTED', metadata_json = #{metadataJson}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where asset_id = #{assetId} and status = 'GENERATING' and del_flag = '0'

update ai_video_asset set status = 'GENERATING', metadata_json = case when metadata_json is null then null else json_remove(metadata_json, '$.generationError') end, generation_params_json = #{generationParamsJson}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where asset_id = #{assetId} and status = 'REJECTED' and del_flag = '0'

update ai_video_asset set del_flag = '2', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where asset_id = #{assetId} and del_flag = '0' and status not in ('GENERATING', 'SUBMITTED', 'PROCESSING', 'VALIDATING', 'QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'WAITING_CALLBACK', 'RETRYING', 'NEEDS_REVIEW', 'QUALITY_CHECK')
mapper.select: select count(1) from ai_video_asset where source_asset_id = #{sourceAssetId} and asset_type = 'VIDEO_CLIP' and del_flag = '0'
select count(1) from ai_video_asset where asset_id != #{assetId} and del_flag = '0' and (object_key = #{storagePath} or preview_object_key = #{storagePath})
mapper.update: update ai_video_asset a left join ai_video_generation_task t on t.asset_id = a.asset_id and (t.del_flag = '0' or t.del_flag is null) and t.status in ('PENDING', 'QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'WAITING_CALLBACK', 'QUALITY_CHECK', 'RETRYING', 'NEEDS_REVIEW', 'SUBMITTED', 'PROCESSING', 'VALIDATING') set a.status = 'REJECTED', a.metadata_json = json_set(coalesce(a.metadata_json, json_object()), '$.generationError', '检测到资产停留在生成中但没有活动任务，已安全解锁，请检查提示词后手动重试'), a.update_by = 'ai-video-recovery', a.update_time = now() where a.del_flag = '0' and a.status = 'GENERATING' and t.task_id is null and coalesce(a.update_time, a.create_time) < date_sub(now(), interval 2 minute)
